claims.claim_text: 技術基礎是 Google DeepMind 在 2024 年發表的 SynthID-Text
claims.evidence: Claude's text watermark is a version of the SynthID-Text approach published by Google DeepMind in a Nature paper in 2024.
claims.note: Attribution, year and provenance all match; source adds that it was a Nature paper, which the post omits (omission, not inflation).

claims.claim_text: 官方說法是「在內部測試中，我們沒有看到浮水印對 Claude 文字的內容、創意程度或可讀性造成影響」
claims.evidence: In internal testing, we've seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude's text.
claims.note: Translated quote. The underlying English sentence exists verbatim; the zh-tw rendering is faithful clause-for-clause and does not strengthen it — the 'in internal testing' scope qualifier is preserved.

claims.claim_text: 它不改寫內容，而是換掉「在語意等價的候選詞之間挑一個」時所用的隨機來源，改由密碼學金鑰加上前文脈絡決定
claims.evidence: the watermark only changes the source of the randomness used to pick among words … Instead of using an arbitrary random number generator to pick the next word, watermarking uses the key and a few words that come before to settle what word the model should pick.
claims.note: Mechanism matches: randomness source swapped, key + preceding context as the decision input. Source frames the candidate set as 'low-stakes choices'; the post's 「語意等價的候選詞」 is a fair rendering, not an upgrade.

claims.claim_text: 而且不產生額外 token、不帶可追溯到特定個人、組織或對話的資訊
claims.evidence: Because it produces no extra tokens, the model is the same price to serve and use. … There's nothing in the watermark, or its key, that would allow anyone to recover any information about the user, their organization, or their chats with Claude.
claims.note: Both halves supported. 個人/組織/對話 maps to user/organization/chats.

claims.claim_text: 候選詞太少的事實性句子、樣本太短、或被大幅改寫過的文字，訊號都會變弱甚至消失
claims.evidence: Watermarking is sparser on factual passages where there are fewer choices that can be made without decreasing the accuracy of the text. … Detecting a watermark also doesn't work well on small samples … Light editing probably won't remove the watermark completely; a complete rewrite where every word is replaced will.
claims.note: All three limitation clauses are in the source. Adversarial check on the third: the source's removal threshold is 'a complete rewrite where every word is replaced', whereas the post says 大幅改寫 — a broader trigger. But the post's consequent is the weaker spectrum 「變弱甚至消失」 rather than an assertion of removal, so net strength is at or below the source's. Recorded deflated rather than inflated; no fix needed.

claims.claim_text: TLC「探索 14,290,224 個相異狀態，約 21 分鐘，證明 10 個 safety invariant 與 2 個 liveness property」
claims.location: item #02 lede (echoed in the hero lede as 一千四百多萬個狀態 and in the sidecar summary)
claims.evidence: TLC explores 14,290,224 distinct states in about 21 minutes and proves 10 safety invariants and 2 liveness properties.
claims.note: Digit-for-digit match on all four figures. The hero lede's 一千四百多萬 is a correct rounding of 14,290,224.

claims.claim_text: GC 標記某個 blob 待刪的同時，客戶端重新上傳一份 byte-for-byte 相同的內容（同 digest、同 S3 key），交錯之後被刪掉的是剛提交的那一份
claims.evidence: GC verifies the blob has zero references and decides to delete it. Concurrently, a client pushes an image containing that exact blob. Same digest, same key. The upload writes to S3 and commits a new reference. GC's delete lands and removes the object that a just-committed manifest now points to.
claims.note: Adversarially re-fetched specifically for the byte-for-byte / same-digest / same-key wording; the source states 'Upload the same blob twice and you get byte-identical data at the same key' and 'Same digest, same key.' Interleaving and victim both match.

claims.claim_text: 根因是 reference 在 MySQL、bytes 在 S3，兩個系統之間做不出 atomic transaction
claims.evidence: the references live in MySQL and the bytes live in S3, and there is no transaction that spans both systems.
claims.note: Presented in the source as its own diagnosis, so the post's attribution of the causal link is legitimate.

claims.claim_text: 修法是把 S3 bucket versioning 當成 delete fence：標記時記下 version ID，清理時只刪那一個版本
claims.evidence: it deletes only that version … GC deletes `v1`, and only `v1`. `v2`, the version the new manifest was built on, is untouched.
claims.note: Fix mechanism (record the observed version ID at mark time, delete only that version) matches the source.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare Gateway 不再靠 hostname 或 URL pattern 猜哪些是 MCP 流量，改看協定層的 MCP-Protocol-Version 標頭
claims.evidence: Those signals are still useful for finding traffic from older clients and providing historical visibility, but they're very basic. They miss an MCP server at an ordinary URL like https://tools.example.com/api, which is not uncommon.
claims.note: Re-fetched twice with a narrowed prompt to test this specifically. The source never says Gateway stopped using hostname/path heuristics; it explicitly keeps them as still useful for older clients and historical visibility, and positions the MCP-Protocol-Version header as a more specific additional signal. 「不再靠」 asserts a replacement the source does not claim — supplementation presented as abandonment.
claims.fix_applied: Rewrote the opening sentence to 「Cloudflare Gateway 判斷 MCP 流量的依據，從 hostname 與 URL pattern 這類很基本的訊號，多加上了協定層的 MCP-Protocol-Version 標頭；舊訊號留著找舊版 client 與看歷史軌跡，但會漏掉架在一般網址上的 MCP server。」 — supplementation rather than replacement, with the source's own reason for keeping the old signals and its own stated gap. No new fact introduced beyond the quoted evidence.

claims.claim_text: MCP 2026-07-28 規格「更進一步要求每個 POST 請求都帶上它」
claims.evidence: The MCP 2026-07-28 specification goes further and requires it on every POST request.
claims.note: Translated quote; underlying English sentence exists verbatim and the rendering matches strength exactly.

claims.claim_text: 「Gateway 在每個經 TLS 檢查的請求上檢查該標頭並據以分類」
claims.evidence: Gateway inspects that header on every TLS-inspected request and classifies the traffic accordingly
claims.note: Faithful translation of a real sentence, including the TLS-inspection scope limit which is the load-bearing caveat.

claims.claim_text: policy 端露出的是 experimental.is_mcp 這個布林 selector，另加一個 mcp_portal 的 Traffic Source 標籤，用來把經 Portal 代理的請求和直連的請求分開
claims.evidence: The selector is a boolean. … When MCP Portal traffic routes through Gateway it carries an `mcp_portal` Traffic Source, which lets policy distinguish Portal-proxied requests from direct employee connections.
claims.note: Selector name, its boolean type, the Traffic Source label and its Portal-proxied-vs-direct purpose all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 未經核准的 shadow MCP server 是一種威脅，核准過卻繞開 Portal 直連是另一種
claims.evidence: Shadow MCP is a connection to a server the organization has not approved … Portal bypass is different: it starts with an approved server that the organization has placed in an MCP Portal, but an employee connects to its upstream URL directly and skips the Portal's Access policy
claims.note: The two-threat distinction is the source's own, not the post's synthesis.

claims.claim_text: 三支 shell script，一支從 git 更新 curl 並跑測試，一支解析 log 產圖，一支用 crontab 每 20 分鐘叫起前面兩支，目前 24 個測項跑完一輪大約六分鐘
claims.location: item #04 lede (20-minute figure also echoed in the hero lede and sidecar summary)
claims.evidence: I created a first shell script that updates the curl source code from git, it configures and builds it. Then it runs a bunch of tests … A third script is invoked from a crontab every twenty minutes … As I write this, we have 24 tests and a full test round completes in about six minutes on my machine.
claims.note: Script count, roles, cron interval, test count and round duration all match. Source scopes the six minutes to 'on my machine'; the post drops that qualifier but the figure is unchanged and the post keeps 大約.

claims.claim_text: 他對這個做法的自評是「有總比沒有好」
claims.evidence: Something should be better than nothing.
claims.note: Translated quote; the English sentence exists and the rendering is faithful and non-strengthening.

claims.claim_text: 長期趨勢那一段則用 LTTB 降採樣配上 Mann-Kendall 檢定與 Sen's Slope，另外替每個測項手工設一條叫 stake 的門檻線
claims.evidence: I introduced a concept I call stakes. As in a stake pole. A marker. An arbitrary threshold set manually for each specific test.
claims.note: LTTB downsampling for long-term graphs and Mann-Kendall + Sen's Slope for trend detection are both present in the fetched text; the stake threshold is quoted above, including that it is set manually per test.

claims.claim_text: 「只花了幾個小時，我們就收到第一批改善數字的提案」
claims.evidence: It only took hours until we had the first proposed changes to improve some numbers, and soon we had a few merges to that affect.
claims.note: Adversarially probed: the first fetch returned NOT FOUND against an invented English phrasing, but the real sentence exists and the translation tracks it clause by clause. No strengthening; the post also drops the follow-on merges claim rather than adding to it.

claims.claim_text: MCP 2026-07-28 規格把協定從需要常駐 session 改成完全無狀態的 HTTP 設計，initialize/initialized 握手與 Mcp-Session-Id 標頭一起從請求路徑上消失 …「沒有協定 session 需要保存」
claims.evidence: The new protocol removes the required handshake, the `Mcp-Session-Id` header, and protocol sessions from the core request path. … There is no protocol session to store.
claims.note: Translated quote maps to 'There is no protocol session to store'. Handshake + Mcp-Session-Id removal from the request path is stated verbatim. Source scopes removal to the 'core request path', which the post preserves.

claims.claim_text: 每個請求自己帶協定版本、client 身分與能力
claims.evidence: Each request carries the protocol version, client identity, and client capabilities it needs.
claims.note: Three-item list matches exactly.

claims.claim_text: 新增的 Mcp-Method 與 Mcp-Name 標頭讓 gateway 與 WAF 不必解 JSON body 就能路由與限流
claims.evidence: The new specification requires `Mcp-Method` and `Mcp-Name` headers on Streamable HTTP requests … A gateway, rate limiter, or Web Application Firewall can now make decisions from headers without parsing arbitrary JSON.
claims.note: Header names, the gateway/rate-limiter/WAF consumers and the no-JSON-parsing benefit all match.

claims.claim_text: 原本依賴串流的 elicitation 換成 Multi-Round-Trip Requests，server 回 input_required，client 帶著收集到的輸入重試
claims.evidence: A server can return an `input_required` result that describes what it needs. The client collects the answer and retries the operation with that input.
claims.note: The input_required / collect / retry cycle matches the source verbatim in substance.

claims.claim_text: 授權那側棄用 Dynamic Client Registration，改推預先註冊的 client 與 Client ID Metadata Documents
claims.evidence: MCP now prefers pre-registered clients … then Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) for dynamic registrations, with Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) as a fallback
claims.note: The second half (preference for pre-registered clients and CIMD) is supported. The first half is not: the source keeps DCR as an explicit fallback in the preference ordering, which is not 棄用. A preference ranking is reported as a removal — the strength upgrade changes what an implementer would conclude about DCR support.
claims.fix_applied: Rewrote to 「授權那側改成有優先順序：先是預先註冊的 client，其次是給動態註冊用的 Client ID Metadata Documents，Dynamic Client Registration 退成 fallback，另外採用 RFC 9207 的 issuer 識別。」 — reproduces the source's three-tier preference ordering with DCR as fallback rather than dropped. No new fact introduced beyond the quoted evidence.

claims.claim_text: 並採用 RFC 9207 的 issuer 識別
claims.evidence: The specification also adopts RFC 9207 issuer identification.
claims.note: RFC number and subject match.

claims.claim_text: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 把「總共 2.4T、啟動 95B」的 MoE 放上 Hugging Face
claims.evidence: Number of Parameters: 2.4T in total and 95B activated
claims.note: Model card figures match the post and the model name. Timeliness: annual (current-version statement), source is the live model card and contemporaneous with the post.

claims.claim_text: 官方說這是「Qwen3.8 首度把 Qwen-Max 等級的模型帶進開放釋出」
claims.evidence: For the first time, Qwen3.8 brings a Qwen-Max-class model to open release.
claims.note: Translated quote of a real model-card sentence; the superlative 首度 corresponds to the source's own 'For the first time' and is not added by the post. The item title rests on the same source sentence.

claims.claim_text: 92 層裡混用 Gated DeltaNet 這類線性注意力與 Gated Attention，512 個 expert 每個 token 路由 10 個外加 1 個共享 expert
claims.evidence: Number of Layers: 92 … 23 × (3 × (Gated DeltaNet → MoE) → 1 × (Gated Attention → MoE)) … Number of Experts: 512 … Number of Activated Experts: 10 Routed + 1 Shared
claims.note: Layer count, the hybrid pattern, expert count and 10-routed-plus-1-shared routing all match the card.

claims.claim_text: 脈絡長度原生 262,144 token，可延伸到 1,010,000
claims.evidence: Context Length: 262,144 natively and extensible up to 1,010,000 tokens.
claims.note: Both figures and the native-vs-extensible distinction match.

claims.claim_text: OpScale 改以算子層級的彈性當作擴縮原語，在最多 40 顆 A100 與 24 顆 GB200 上用生產環境 trace 評估，達成 SLO 時最多少用 36.3% 的 GPU 與 28% 的電力，或在固定成本預算下多拿到 44% 的吞吐
claims.evidence: operator-level elasticity as a viable scaling primitive … up to 40 A100s and 24 GB200s … up to 36.3% fewer GPUs and 28% less power … 44% higher throughput under fixed cost budgets
claims.note: All four figures and both hardware counts match the abstract. The post preserves the abstract's 'up to' as 最多 rather than asserting a flat reduction.

claims.claim_text: 現行做法多半把整個模型當成單一的擴縮單位，簡單，但抓不到推論負載的細部動態，於是不是在突發需求下違反 SLO，就是讓 GPU 大幅閒置
claims.evidence: Existing approaches primarily treat the entire model as a monolithic scaling unit--simple but unable to capture the fine-grained dynamics of inference workloads. … such coarse-grained scaling often leads to either SLO violations under bursty demand or significant GPU under-utilization.
claims.note: The causal chain is the paper's own framing, including the either/or failure mode. Post's 多半 tracks the abstract's 'primarily'.

claims.claim_text: 沒有硬體協助、暫存器得自己收，RISC-V 大約要 44 個 cycle，ARM Cortex-M0 是 27 個
claims.evidence: at least 44-cycle cost before any work is done in the C handler … 27-cycle cost
claims.note: Both figures match, as does the mechanism (no hardware register stacking on RISC-V vs Cortex-M0's hardware push). The post's 大約 is weaker than the source's 'at least' — deflated, which is never an error. Post does not mention the source's RV32E variant (38 cycles), an omission rather than a misstatement.

claims.claim_text: 定址模式缺了 scaled register（陣列存取被迫從一道指令拆成多道）
claims.evidence: x86 has addressing modes of the form [ebx + esi * 4] … ARM has [R0, R1, LSL #2] … three instructions for a single array access
claims.note: The post's vague 拆成多道 is weaker than the source's specific 'three instructions' — safe direction. Post omits that Zba's SHxADD later partly mitigates this; an omission, not a contradiction.

claims.claim_text: compressed load/store byte 的 offset 只到 0 至 3 而 ARM 到 31
claims.evidence: What range of offsets can a 16-bit instruction encode? Zero through three. … offsets from zero to 31 for bytes, zero to 62 for halfwords
claims.note: Both ranges match, and the post correctly scopes the ARM figure to byte offsets.

claims.claim_text: 作者也數了 Linux kernel：「平均每兩個函式就有一個用到、或本來可以用到依位元值分支的指令」，共 35,393 處
claims.evidence: There were 35,393 instances [of TBZ/TBNZ] … 70,109 instances of RET … on average every other function uses or could use an instruction to branch on the value of a bit
claims.note: Translated quote is faithful. The 35,393 figure is exact. Source specifies a Raspberry Pi kernel image, which the post generalizes to 'Linux kernel' — a mild loss of precision but not a strength upgrade; the count itself is unchanged.

claims.claim_text: nixpkgs-multiverse 用單一 flake input 提供 Nixpkgs 歷來每個套件的每個版本，新加的 fast 模式乾脆整段跳過求值，直接從 cache 取預先算好的 store path
claims.evidence: gives you every version of every package that ever shipped in Nixpkgs from a single flake input. … it gives you the store path for every indexed version of every package. This lets you skip the download and evaluation of Nixpkgs and get the store path straight from the cache.
claims.note: Both the single-flake-input framing and the skip-evaluation mechanism match the source.

claims.claim_text: 作者的說法就是「最快的求值是不發生的那一次」
claims.evidence: The fastest evaluation is the one that never happens.
claims.note: The English sentence exists verbatim and the translation is faithful. Attribution nuance checked adversarially: the source presents the line as an epigraph jokingly credited to 'Sun Tzu, The Art of Evaluation'. Since that attribution is transparently a gag, the post's 作者的說法 is the accurate real-world attribution rather than a misattribution.

claims.claim_text: 機制是 mkFakeDerivation——把 Nix 的 string context 掛到 store path 上，做出不需要 .drv、也不需要求值的類 derivation 物件
claims.evidence: We attach 'context' to the String … `builtins.appendContext` lets you attach it by hand … This is tomberek's `mkFakeDerivation` trick from fastpkgs, and it is an amazing trick to circumvent needing `--impure`.
claims.note: Mechanism name and the string-context-on-a-store-path technique match. Source credits the trick to tomberek/fastpkgs; the post names the mechanism without claiming authorship, so no false attribution.

claims.claim_text: 截至發文，索引到的 271,187 個套件版本全部還活在 binary cache 裡，大約 14.8 TB，最早回溯到 2013 年
claims.evidence: all 271,187 of them are alive … 14.8 TB of unpacked software from 2013 onward … All of them, down to every NAR payload file.
claims.note: All three figures match, including the total-survival claim which the source states emphatically. Timeliness: this is the most volatile figure in the post, but the post already carries the dated hedge 截至發文 and the source is two days old at publication, so no additional hedge is required.

claims.claim_text: ActivityPub 之所以成為真的跑起來的聯邦協定，正因為它的核心刻意平凡：JSON 物件、HTTP GET 與 POST、URL、collection、actor 與 inbox/outbox，作者的結論是「無聊才做得出來」
claims.evidence: ActivityPub works because its core is intentionally ordinary. … JSON-ish objects, HTTP GET, HTTP POST, URLs, collections, actors, inboxes, outboxes. None of this is dazzling. Boring is implementable.
claims.note: Translated quote renders 'Boring is implementable.' faithfully. The primitives list matches item for item; the source's 'JSON-ish' is slightly hedged relative to the post's 「JSON 物件」, but the difference does not carry argumentative weight.

claims.claim_text: client-to-server 與 server-to-server 兩層，activity 就是主詞動詞受詞的句子，而 user@domain 這種帳號寫法其實來自 WebFinger 而非協定本身
claims.evidence: The ActivityPub specification describes two layers: a client-to-server API and a server-to-server federation protocol. … An activity is a sentence: subject, verb, object. … Even the familiar `user@domain` handle is not fundamental to ActivityPub. It comes through WebFinger
claims.note: All three sub-claims land verbatim, including the WebFinger provenance point.

claims.claim_text: 認證用的 HTTP Signatures 在 Fediverse 用的是過期草案而不是 RFC 9421
claims.evidence: The deployed Fediverse grew around the older draft-cavage-http-signatures-12, an Internet-Draft that is now expired and archived. … The IETF work later produced RFC 9421, HTTP Message Signatures, published in February 2024, with a different design.
claims.note: Re-fetched specifically to confirm RFC 9421 is named in the source rather than supplied by the author — it is, with a publication date and a note that it has a different design.

claims.claim_text: 端對端加密沒有內建，「instance 就是信任邊界」
claims.evidence: That gives the Fediverse an access-control model. It does not give it end-to-end encryption. … the instance is the trust boundary.
claims.note: Translated quote maps one-to-one onto a real sentence; the no-E2EE claim is stated flatly by the source too.
